verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI model and API product, because model vendors can ship downloadable weights or on-prem deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Claude can be self-hosted. The API, Managed Agents (which 'runs in managed infrastructure') and Google Cloud access are all vendor- or cloud-hosted. MCP tunnels only connect hosted Claude to MCP servers on a private network; they do not run the model yourself.
